definitions.explanation: A man who is considered physically attractive. A somewhat formal or literary term.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{美男子|びだんし}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: He is famous for being a handsome man.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}に{出|で}てくる{美男子|びだんし}にあこがれる{女性|じょせい}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many women admire the handsome men who appear in movies.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}す{美男子|びだんし}といえば、{光源氏|ひかるげんじ}がよく{挙|あ}げられる。
examples.english: When it comes to famous handsome men in history, Hikaru Genji is often mentioned.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or formal word. In everyday conversation, イケメン is far more common for describing a handsome man. {美男子|びだんし} has a classical, refined nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美男子|びだんし}で{有名|ゆうめい} (famous for being handsome)
- {美男|びなん}{美女|びじょ} (handsome men and beautiful women)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イケメン: handsome guy — modern, casual, much more commonly used
- {美男|びなん}: handsome man — shorter form, also somewhat literary
- ハンサム: handsome — loanword from English, slightly dated
